newsitem.title: USA: Mercantile Bancorp completes Roosevelt deal.
newsitem.headline: Mercantile Bancorp completes Roosevelt deal.

text.p: Mercantile Bancorp Inc said Tuesday it has completed its acquisition of thrift holding company Roosevelt Financial Group Inc, which has $7.8-billion in assets. Both companies are based in St. Louis.
Mercantile said it now has the number one deposit market share in the state of Missouri.
According to the terms of the merger, Roosevelt shareholders about 0.2853 shares of Mercantile common stock and $7.10 in cash for each share of Roosevelt stock, or $22 cash.

Of the seven million share total buyback authorized in connection with the merger, Mercantile repurchased 4.3 million common shares of Mercantile common stock at an average per share price of $57.70 during the first half of 1997 in open market transactions, Mercantile said, adding that it expects to complete the buyback during the third quarter.
Mercantile shares closed up 1-7/8 at 62-5/8 Tuesday.
